title: tallyCycleVotesInput
description: The request tally-cycle-votes.mjs reads via --request or stdin. closedAt bounds which already-recorded votes enter the immutable first tally; it describes the requested close instant but does not itself prove an admitted monthly cycle calendar boundary.

closedAt.description: ISO date/time cutoff for the immutable first tally. Votes recorded after this instant are excluded. Separate governance/calendar evidence is still required before treating the instant as an authorized monthly close.
